deficiencies.description: The rewrite adds that the stained slice through a tumour illustrates the explantation of a tumour ('illustrates this'), linking the figure to the preceding sentence, whereas the lecturer only stated that the slide shows a slice through a tumour and a stain to examine morphology.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: often they will explant the tumor. Here you're looking at a slice through a tumor and a stain to look at the morphology.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A slice through a tumour, with a stain to show the morphology, illustrates this [FIGURE].

considerations.sourcePassage: Whoops, I forgot to start my clock. Okay.
considerations.reason: This is an incidental remark to the audience / self-talk by the lecturer, which is allowed to be omitted.

considerations.sourcePassage: Primary cells really don't grow in culture.
considerations.reason: 'really don't' is colloquial emphasis rather than a scientific hedge, so rendering it as 'do not grow in culture' is an acceptable stylistic change.

considerations.sourcePassage: with regard to the contributions of things like the stroma and other things.
considerations.reason: Replacing 'other things' with 'other components' is a valid stylistic variation with the same meaning.
